decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northern or southern walls of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Construction of the first floor extension hereby approved shall not commence until the existing (unauthorised) canopy across the front elevation of the dwelling house and extension to the front of the garage have been demolished, and the alterations to the roof over the single-storey rear extension completed.
description: Erection of new first floor side extension, demolition of front extension to garage, and retention of existing single-storey rear extension (with reduction in height of roof).
